gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-syncopate: Bruno Ace SC spreads its wide-open letters out like beads on a thread, while Syncopate draws a steady, technical line beneath. Bruno earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-manrope: Manrope has a bright gap at every curve and barely any step from capital to lowercase, a friendly sans under Bruno Ace SC. One is made to show off, the other to be read.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-montserrat: Wide, beaded, and bold in personality, Bruno Ace SC leads with open shapes and no thinning anywhere. Montserrat follows with generous counters and a line that glides along like wire.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and friendly, its wide e never squeezed shut. Beneath Bruno Ace SC's spaced-out display letters, that plain sans gives a taller, more compact lowercase, so the page moves from showpiece to something easy to settle into.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-switzer: Expressive from the first line, Bruno Ace SC spreads open letters across the page like beads on a thread. Switzer, a sans-serif with wire-like forms and a tall waist line, is the one made for sustained reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-work-sans: Distinctive in every letter, Bruno Ace SC strings its open shapes out with no thinning at all. Work Sans, a sans with a high mean line and tidy c tips, is the sturdier half of the pair.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-archivo: Heavy diagonals, wide horseshoe curves. Cherry Swash carries that weight up top, and Archivo, a plain sans with a tall x-height and outward-opening curves, gives the text a more spacious, editorial feel.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-asap: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and keeps its joins thick where strokes meet. Asap, a sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, would carry a long passage in a readable, steady way.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Commanding in its heavy diagonals and horseshoe c, Cherry Swash leads, while Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans with a high mean line, follows with curves that never crowd. Give the heading plenty of size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is a tall-bodied sans with curvy, unclamped letters. Under Cherry Swash, whose wide horseshoe c and heavy diagonals feel commanding, it adds a lighter, wire-like line that keeps the pair lively without competing.
